subject: HackStage: Request for community credits and trial extension
messages:
From: Sasha Gomez <sasha@hackstage.org>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HackStage: Request for community credits and trial extension

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking a look—I'm Sasha, one of the community leads at HackStage. We run a series of 48-hour community sprints for open-source maintainers and student teams; next one is July 8-10 and typically draws ~150 active devs and 25 maintainers.

We'd like to request a promotional bundle from Redwood for two things:
- A pool of free API credits (we typically ask for enough tokens to support ~2k model minutes of active usage across the weekend) to give to participating maintainers and mentors.
- A 60-day trial extension for any maintainer accounts that sign up through our organizer flow (so projects can complete end-to-end demos without hitting quota).

Attached is a quick flyer and a conservative usage estimate (usage_estimate.xlsx). We plan to promote Redwood as the "model runtime sponsor" on the event page and include the Redwood logo on the welcome slide and website.

Could you let me know the simplest way to get a promo/code issued and what information you need for verification (org legal name, event page, expected billing contact)? We can also provide a short testimonial post-event if that helps.

Thanks,

—Sasha Gomez
Community Lead, HackStage Collective
Sasha@guilds+hackstage.org

Attachment: hackstage_flyer.pdf (PDF flyer, 1 page)
Attachment: usage_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet, estimated token usage)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Gomez <sasha@hackstage.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HackStage: Request for community credits and trial extension

Hi Sasha — really appreciate the note and the materials. HackStage sounds great and the timing works. Quick clarifying questions so I can scope the right package and get approval: 

1) Expected total token budget in plain numbers (e.g., 250k tokens or X model-minutes). Your spreadsheet is helpful but if you can give a single headline estimate that speeds approvals.
2) How many distinct maintainer accounts will receive the 60-day extension? Is this per-project or per-email signup?
3) Do you need a single promo code (for everyone) or individual codes per maintainer?

If you prefer, we can offer a pooled credit grant for the event plus a separate per-email trial extension. For quick internal routing, please confirm whether HackStage is requesting branding/sponsor signage (we're happy to support that).

I'll loop in Lauren from partnerships to coordinate the promotional collateral and the credits process.

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Partnerships Associate
Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com

(On Wed, Jun 15, 2027, Sasha wrote: "Thanks for taking a look—I'm Sasha..." )
From: Sasha Gomez <sasha@hackstage.org>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HackStage: Request for community credits and trial extension

Hi Priya — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Lauren in. Answers below and a couple of notes: 

1) Headline estimate: 350,000 tokens total across the event (range: 250k–500k depending on adoption). That maps to ~3,500 model-minutes on the workload we run (claude-like short chat sessions + some batch evaluation).
2) Trial extension: we'd like it per-email signup for maintainers — we typically invite ~25 maintainers and expect ~18 to accept. If a per-email extension is easier operationally, we can lock it to verified maintainer emails.
3) Promo approach: one public promo code for attendees is fine for the demo day/session; for maintainers we'd prefer individual extensions tied to their email.

We will include Redwood on the sponsor banner and do a 90-second shoutout at kickoff. Here is the HubSpot event record and a drive folder with assets: https://hubspot.example.com/engagements/OMH-10234 and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEFghIJkl-MockLink

If you can propose a credits number (e.g., 30k–40k credits for the pool + 60-day or 90-day per-email extensions) we can sign a short promo agreement.

Cheers,
Sasha

Attachment: usage_estimate.xlsx (updated worksheet)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: HackStage: Request for community credits and trial extension

Looping you both in for approval. Brief summary: HackStage (external org) requests a pooled event credit grant to support demos (~350k token estimate) and per-email trial extensions for ~25 maintainers. They will provide sponsor signage and promo placement in return. Attachments: hackstage_flyer.pdf, usage_estimate.xlsx.

Proposal from my side:
- 35,000 promotional credits allocated to the event pool (usable by anyone during the two-day sprint).
- 90-day trial extension for up to 25 unique maintainer emails, gated to verified project maintainer emails.
- Standard promo T&Cs (no resale, event-only usage, one extension per email).

Rationale: promotes adoption among maintainers, good branding opportunity, modest credits relative to typical event uplift. If we want to be conservative we can reduce to 20k credits and 60-day extensions.

Please reply with APPROVE / ADJUST / DECLINE. If APPROVE, I will send the sponsor agreement and request a marketing asset slot.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Partnerships Associate, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com

Attachment: credits_allocation_note.txt (internal note, 1 page)
